reasoning_content:
Wasm copy completed. Next, create .env from .env.defaults and set the following:
- SESSION_KEY: 32-byte hex
- CRYPTO_SECRET: random string
- WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW: dev password
- STORAGE_KEY/STORAGE_SECRET: random strings

The default file has inline comments (like `NODE_ENV=production # We want...`). Note: dotenv parses `#` as the start of an inline comment, so values like `production # We want to simulate...` will just become `production`. In fact, dotenv strips out inline comments. Let me check how the app loads the environment — it's probably using dotenv. Inline comments in dotenv: `KEY=value # comment` → dotenv strips ` # comment`. Yeah, dotenv handles inline comments (requires a space before #). Values with `#` in the middle without a space would be a problem, but here they all have a space.

However, to be safe, I'll create a clean .env without inline comments, with generated secrets included.

Generate secrets: use openssl rand -hex 32 for SESSION_KEY, and something similar for CRYPTO_SECRET.

Let's write .env.

action.command:
cd /workspace && SESS=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && CRYPTO=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && SKEY=$(openssl rand -hex 16) && SSEC=$(openssl rand -hex 16) && cat > .env <<EOF
NODE_ENV=production
APP_ENV=production
LOG_LEVEL=info
COOKIE_NAME=app-cookie
BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000
WEBAPP_APP_TITLE=buildplace.io

DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev
MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_test
BYPASS_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev
SHADOW_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_shadow
TEST_DIRECT_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_test
RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10000000000

VALKEY_SERVER=localhost
VALKEY_PORT=6379
VALKEY_PERSISTENT_SERVER=localhost
VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PORT=6380
BULL_PREFIX=local

WEBAPP_DOMAIN=http://localhost:3000
WEBAPP_SELFSERVING_TILESERVER=https://example.com
WEBAPP_OGRE_API=https://ogre.example.com
WEBAPP_MAP_MAPTILER_KEY=your_maptiler_key_here
WEBAPP_MAP_GEOAPIFY_KEY=your_geoapify_key_here
WEBAPP_PUBLIC_URL=""
WEBAPP_SELFSERVING_DGM_TILES=https://example.com/tiles
WEBAPP_TILESERVER_KEY=your_tileserver_key_here
WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW=devpassword123

SESSION_KEY=$SESS
STORAGE_KEY=$SKEY
STORAGE_SECRET=$SSEC
CRYPTO_SECRET=$CRYPTO

STORAGE_BUCKET=dev
STORAGE_URL=storage.example.com

MAIL_SMTP=mail.example.com
MAIL_NOREPLY_USER=noreply@example.com
MAIL_NOREPLY_PW=your_mail_password

SELFSERVING_API=https://selfservice.example.com
SELFSERVING_KEY=your_selfserving_key_here

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=buildplace
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318

XPLANBOX_URL=https://xplanbox.example.com
XPLANBOX_USER=your_xplanbox_user
XPLANBOX_PASSWORD=your_xplanbox_password

WEBAPP_COMFORT_ANALYSIS_SERVER=http://localhost:3100
EOF
echo "created .env" && grep -c . .env
